title: Oracle HCM Cloud Technical
description:
Choosing Capgemini means choosing a company where you will be empowered to shape your career in the way you’d like, where you’ll be supported and inspired by a collaborative community of colleagues around the world, and where you’ll be able to reimagine what’s possible. Join us and help the world’s leading organizations unlock the value of technology and build a more sustainable, more inclusive world.

**Your Role**
-------------

We are looking for an experienced **Oracle HCM Cloud Technical Consultant** with strong expertise in Oracle Fusion HCM technical development, integrations, reporting, and data migration. The candidate will be responsible for designing, developing, and supporting Oracle HCM Cloud solutions across global implementations and support engagements.

* Design, develop, and support Oracle HCM Cloud technical solutions.
* Build and maintain integrations using **OIC, HCM Extracts, HDL, HSDL, REST/SOAP APIs** .
* Develop reports using **BI Publisher, OTBI, and Fast Formulas** .
* Perform data migration, data conversion, and bulk data uploads using HDL/HSDL.

**Your Profile**
----------------

* Work closely with functional teams to understand business requirements and provide technical solutions.
* Troubleshoot production issues and provide timely resolutions.
* Support enhancements, upgrades, testing, and deployment activities.
* Ensure adherence to Oracle best practices and coding standards.

* Strong experience in **Oracle Fusion HCM Cloud Technical** .
* Experience working on **Global HR, Core HR, Talent Management, Compensation, Payroll, Benefits, Recruitment, or Learning Modules** .
* Knowledge of security, roles, and workflow configurations in HCM Cloud.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

**What you'll love about working with us**
------------------------------------------

* We value flexibility and support a healthy work-life balance through remote and hybrid work options.
* Competitive compensation and benefits.
* Career development programs and certifications in cloud technologies.
* A diverse and inclusive workplace that fosters innovation and collaboration.

Capgemini is an AI-powered global business and technology transformation partner, delivering tangible business value. We imagine the future of organizations and make it real with AI, technology and people. With our strong heritage of nearly 60 years, we are a responsible and diverse group of over 420,000 team members in more than 50 countries. We deliver end-to-end services and solutions with our deep industry expertise and strong partner ecosystem, leveraging our capabilities across strategy, technology, design, engineering and business operations. The Group reported 2025 global revenues of €22.5 billion.

Capgemini in India comprises nearly 235,000 team members working across 13 locations: Bangalore, Bhubaneswar, Chennai, Coimbatore, Gandhinagar, Gurugram, Hyderabad, Kolkata, Mumbai, Noida, Pune, Salem, and Tiruchirappalli.

Make it real | www.capgemini.com/in-en .

title: HR & Project Management
description:
**Job Description**

We are looking for an experienced and responsible **HR \& Project Management professional** with 4 years of experience to manage HR activities, employee coordination, project planning, task tracking, and day\-to\-day team operations.

The candidate should have strong communication, coordination, organizational, and problem\-solving skills, along with the ability to manage multiple responsibilities and ensure projects are completed on time.

**Key Responsibilities HR Responsibilities**

* Manage day\-to\-day HR operations and employee coordination.
* Handle recruitment, candidate screening, interview scheduling, and onboarding.
* Maintain employee records, attendance, leave, and HR documentation.
* Coordinate with employees regarding company policies and HR\-related matters.
* Support employee engagement and performance management activities.
* Prepare HR reports and maintain proper documentation.
* Coordinate with management on employee\-related requirements.
* Ensure smooth communication between management and employees.

**Project Management Responsibilities**

* Plan, coordinate, and track ongoing projects.
* Assign tasks to team members and monitor progress.
* Follow up with team members to ensure timely completion of tasks.
* Maintain project schedules, deadlines, and status reports.
* Coordinate between different teams and departments.
* Identify project delays or issues and communicate them to management.
* Conduct regular project follow\-ups and maintain MOM/action items.
* Prepare daily/weekly project status updates.
* Ensure project requirements and deliverables are completed as planned.
* Support management in planning and executing new projects.

**Required Skills**

* 4 years of relevant experience in HR, Project Coordination, or Project Management.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
* Good English speaking and writing skills.
* Strong team coordination and follow\-up skills.
* Excellent organizational and time\-management skills.
* Ability to manage multiple tasks and projects simultaneously.
* Good problem\-solving and decision\-making skills.
* Strong documentation and reporting skills.
* Ability to coordinate effectively with management and team members.
* Proficiency in MS Excel, Word, Google Sheets, and Google Workspace.
* Knowledge of project management tools is an added advantage.
* Understanding of recruitment and basic HR processes.
* Ability to work independently and take ownership of assigned responsibilities.
* Strong attention to detail and deadline management.

**Preferred Qualities**

* Responsible and organized approach to work.
* Proactive in identifying and resolving issues.
* Good leadership and coordination abilities.
* Positive and professional attitude.
* Ability to handle confidential employee and company information.
* Willingness to learn and adapt to new processes and tools.

**Company:** Gripples Tech Spark  
**Job Role:** HR \& Project Management  
**Experience:** 4 Years  
**Salary:** ₹25,000 – ₹30,000 per month  
**Location:** Coimbatore

**Educational Qualification**

**Any Bachelor's Degree / MBA in HR / Business Administration / Management or a related field.**

**What We Are Looking For**

A professional who can effectively handle **both HR operations and project coordination**, maintain smooth communication across teams, track deliverables, and support management in achieving organizational goals.

title: HR Trainee Fresher
description:
HR Trainee – Campus Recruitment \& Student Admissions Company: Neelavath Software Solutions Location: Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu Job Type: Full\-time \| Work from Office Experience: Fresher / 0–1 Year

Job Description We are looking for energetic and self\-motivated HR Trainees to join our growing team. The role involves conducting campus recruitment drives, building relationships with colleges, generating student walk\-ins, providing career counselling and converting prospective students into course admissions. This position is suitable for freshers interested in HR, campus recruitment, business development and the EdTech industry.

Key Responsibilities

1\. Campus Recruitment \& College Relations \* Coordinate with college placement officers and conduct campus recruitment drives. \* Organize placement activities, career guidance sessions and student engagement programs. \* Build and maintain relationships with colleges and placement cells.

2\. Lead Generation \& Student Walk\-ins \* Generate prospective student leads through campus drives, telecalling and promotional activities. \* Encourage students to visit our training centre. \* Follow up regularly with interested candidates and achieve walk\-in targets.

3\. Career Counselling \& Admissions \* Counsel students on software training, internships, certifications and placement opportunities. \* Explain course details, fees, training schedules and career prospects. \* Convert enquiries and walk\-ins into successful course admissions. \* Achieve monthly student enrolment targets.

4\. HR \& Administrative Activities \* Maintain student enquiry and admission records. \* Coordinate interviews, recruitment activities and training schedules. \* Prepare daily reports on leads, walk\-ins and admissions.

Candidate Requirements \* Any degree: BBA, MBA, B.Com, B.Sc, BE or equivalent. \* Freshers are welcome. \* Good communication and interpersonal skills. \* Interest in HR, recruitment, counselling and sales. \*

Willingness to travel to colleges for campus recruitment drives. \* Target\-oriented attitude and ability to work independently.

Pay: ₹8,000\.00 \- ₹12,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Commuter assistance
* Food provided
* Internet reimbursement

Work Location: In person
